title: Expanded Auto Require and smarter module IntelliSense
changes: Auto Require recognizes seven Roblox Studio modules: NexusDataStore, ZonePlusNext, BufferUtil, Compression, Signal, Promise and NetStream
Scoped commands /studio/, /github/, /wasm/ and /file/ find the correct module type faster
Studio imports insert appropriate game:GetService ModuleScript paths and warn about Studio-only execution and dependencies
New standalone SignalLite and TableKit modules are included in the public Luau catalog and runnable in browser WASM
Public GitHub module previews record compact reviewed function signatures and comments for autocomplete and hover without storing downloaded source
Additional compatibility, data validation and real WASM tests protect existing editor and import behavior
